tournament.name: April OCC - Qualifier B
tournament.description:
Qualifier Brackets - April 16th @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline April 15th @ 1200 GMT) - The qualifier brackets are seeded based on the position of the player on the OC leader-board at the end of the season.


Round of 8 Finals - April 23rd @ 1300 GMT (deck list deadline April 21st @ 2300 GMT) -The Round of 8 Finals are seeded based on OC leaderboard at the end of the season in addition to the final 2 qualified players being positioned in #7 and #8.
